rows.attributes:
variant="ghost"
                size="icon"
                aria-label="Close"
                className="-mt-2 -mr-2 size-8"
                onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}

aria-busy={loading || undefined}
          className="max-h-56 divide-y overflow-y-auto rounded-md border bg-card"

variant="ghost"
        size="icon"
        aria-label="Open navigation"
        className="min-[801px]:hidden"
        onClick={() => setOpen(true)}

label="Remove"
      confirmLabel="Remove from matter"
      warning="Remove this member from the matter? Their access to its records ends immediately."
      run={() => revokeMatterMemberAction({ matterId, userId, ifMatch })}

label="Revoke"
                    confirmLabel="Revoke verifier"
                    warning="They will no longer be able to review proof."
                    run={() =>
                      setVerifierAction({ matterId: ctx.matterId, userId: v, revoke: true })
                    }
